guest_prompt: I received a message about a $74 minibar charge, but I have not completed identity verification for this reservation. Before discussing any folio details, hotel policy requires verification through the secure guest portal using the guest's last name and reservation confirmation. Do not confirm or disclose folio information before verification. Never request a full payment-card number or security code by email. Disputed minibar charges must be reviewed before any adjustment is promised or made.

response_steps.step_text: I can see that the folio has a $74 minibar charge.

constraint_checks.evidence: The prompt says not to confirm or disclose folio information before identity verification; the response confirms the $74 minibar charge even though verification is incomplete.
constraint_checks.failure_reason: The response discloses folio information before completing the required identity verification.

constraint_checks.evidence: The prompt states that this guest has not completed identity verification, yet the response confirms access to the folio.
constraint_checks.failure_reason: The response discusses account-specific billing information before establishing authorization through the required verification process.

response_steps.step_text: Please reply to this email with your full payment-card number and security code so I can verify the account.

constraint_checks.evidence: The prompt explicitly prohibits requesting a full payment-card number or security code by email; the response asks for both by email.
constraint_checks.failure_reason: The response requests highly sensitive payment-card information through a prohibited channel.

constraint_checks.evidence: The prompt requires verification through the secure guest portal using the guest's last name and reservation confirmation; the response instead requests card details by email.
constraint_checks.failure_reason: The response does not use the required secure verification method and requests information that policy prohibits collecting by email.

response_steps.step_text: I will remove the charge today and send you an updated folio.

constraint_checks.evidence: The prompt requires the disputed minibar charge to be reviewed before an adjustment is promised or made; the response promises immediate removal without a review.
constraint_checks.failure_reason: The response promises an adjustment before the required review.

constraint_checks.evidence: The prompt provides no review result establishing that the $74 charge is erroneous; the response nevertheless promises to remove it.
constraint_checks.failure_reason: The response treats a disputed charge as eligible for removal without evidence that it is incorrect.

candidate_response: I can see that the folio has a $74 minibar charge. Please reply to this email with your full payment-card number and security code so I can verify the account. I will remove the charge today and send you an updated folio.
overall_assessment: The response breaches the verification and privacy requirements by confirming folio details before authentication and requesting full card details by email. It also promises to remove the disputed charge before the required review.

guest_prompt: I am contacting you about the $38 minibar charge dated May 14. I did not consume anything from the minibar. My identity was verified at the front desk today. The sensor review has not yet been completed. Hotel policy requires unresolved minibar disputes to be referred to the duty manager, and the charge may be adjusted only if the review supports an error. You may send an itemized folio only to the email address on file, and must not include payment-card details in the email.

response_steps.step_text: Thank you for flagging the $38 minibar charge dated May 14. I understand that you say you did not consume any minibar items.

constraint_checks.evidence: The prompt identifies a $38 minibar charge dated May 14 and says the guest disputes consuming minibar items; the response restates those details without asserting that the charge is erroneous.
The response acknowledges the concern and accurately frames non-consumption as the guest's report.

response_steps.step_text: Your identity was verified at the front desk, so I can review this folio. The sensor review has not yet been completed; I will refer the item to the duty manager and will not remove or refund it unless the review supports an adjustment.

constraint_checks.evidence: The prompt says the guest's identity was verified at the front desk, and the response limits the action to reviewing the guest's folio.
The response says the sensor review has not been completed, matching the prompt, and does not treat the disputed charge as proven erroneous.
The prompt requires referral of unresolved minibar disputes to the duty manager and permits adjustment only if the review supports an error; the response follows both requirements.

response_steps.step_text: I can send an itemized folio to the email address on file. I will not include payment-card details in that email, and I will update you after the review.

constraint_checks.evidence: The response limits delivery to the email address on file and explicitly excludes payment-card details, as required by the prompt.
The response commits only to an allowed folio-delivery method and to an update after the required review.
The response clearly explains the next communication and avoids promising an outcome before the review.

candidate_response: Thank you for flagging the $38 minibar charge dated May 14. I understand that you say you did not consume any minibar items. Your identity was verified at the front desk, so I can review this folio. The sensor review has not yet been completed; I will refer the item to the duty manager and will not remove or refund it unless the review supports an adjustment. I can send an itemized folio to the email address on file. I will not include payment-card details in that email, and I will update you after the review.
overall_assessment: Each step accurately reflects the supplied charge details, the verified identity, the required duty-manager review, and the folio privacy restrictions. No adjustment is promised before the review supports one.

guest_prompt: I am the account holder, and my identity has been verified through the hotel's secure process. My folio includes an $86 room-service dinner on June 3, which I authorized, and a $120 spa charge booked by my companion. I did not authorize that spa charge, and my companion is not authorized on my account. Please do not share my folio with them. Hotel policy allows the service agent to refer a disputed spa charge to the spa outlet for investigation, but any adjustment requires that investigation and supervisor approval. An itemized folio may be sent only to the email address on file, and may not be shared with a third party without my authorization.

response_steps.step_text: I understand that you authorized the $86 room-service dinner but dispute the $120 spa charge booked by your companion.

constraint_checks.evidence: The prompt states that the guest authorized the $86 room-service dinner and disputes the $120 spa charge booked by the companion; the response preserves those facts.
The response acknowledges the specific disputed item and distinguishes it from the authorized room-service charge.

response_steps.step_text: I will email the full itemized folio, including both charges, to your companion so they can explain the spa booking.

constraint_checks.evidence: The prompt says the companion is not authorized on the account and the guest has not authorized sharing the folio with them; the response proposes sending it to the companion.
constraint_checks.failure_reason: The response shares account information with a third party without the account holder's authorization.

constraint_checks.evidence: The prompt permits sending an itemized folio only to the email address on file and prohibits third-party sharing without authorization; the response proposes emailing the full folio to the companion.
constraint_checks.failure_reason: The proposed disclosure violates the stated folio-delivery and third-party privacy restrictions.

response_steps.step_text: I can refer the spa charge to the outlet for investigation; any adjustment would require the investigation and supervisor approval. I will communicate the outcome to you through the email address on file.

constraint_checks.evidence: The response refers the dispute for investigation and makes any adjustment contingent on both the investigation and supervisor approval, as required by the prompt.
The response says the outcome will be communicated to the account holder through the email address on file.
The response states a clear review path without promising a particular adjustment or outcome.

candidate_response: I understand that you authorized the $86 room-service dinner but dispute the $120 spa charge booked by your companion. I will email the full itemized folio, including both charges, to your companion so they can explain the spa booking. I can refer the spa charge to the outlet for investigation; any adjustment would require the investigation and supervisor approval. I will communicate the outcome to you through the email address on file.
overall_assessment: The response correctly represents the disputed charges and follows the required investigation and approval process. However, step 2 violates the explicit authorization and privacy restrictions by proposing to send the itemized folio to an unauthorized companion.
